ruleset.name: Sane Laravel ruleset
ruleset.description:
Everything from the bundled PHP Mess Detector rulesets, with the few adjustments a Laravel/Filament application needs:
* StaticAccess is disabled: Filament components, facades and Eloquent models are static by design, so the rule only produces noise here. PHPStan/Larastan covers the type-safety part. * CouplingBetweenObjects is raised to 20: Filament resources naturally reference many form/table classes. * UnusedFormalParameter is suppressed per method where the framework requires a signature (e.g. FilamentUser::canAccessPanel()).
